title: Session 48 — Advanced Prompt Engineering + AI Co-Programmer
subtitle: Session 48

concepts.title: Topics covered
concepts.text_md:
- Advanced Prompt Patterns for DevOps workflows
- Chain-of-Thought Prompting — step-by-step AI reasoning
- AI for Code Review and Documentation generation
- AI for Infrastructure as Code — Terraform and Ansible
- AI-Assisted Troubleshooting — feed logs to AI
- Agentic AI Workflows — autonomous task execution

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- Chain-of-thought prompting: adding Think step by step dramatically improves AI output quality
- AI code review catches security issues that human reviewers regularly miss — use always
- Give AI full context: role plus task plus output format plus constraints for best results
- AI for IaC: Write Terraform for 3-tier AWS architecture gives working code in 30 seconds
- Agentic AI takes autonomous actions — the near future of all DevOps operations automation
